I wrote the review to `.social-review.md`. X and LinkedIn fail, and Bluesky passes.

- **X:** It fails because the copy ends with the hashtag `#AIAgents`. The suggested copy drops it.
- **LinkedIn:** It fails because it uses "I" voice ("I have watched this happen on every team I have worked with"). The suggested copy swaps "I" for "we" and changes nothing else.
- **Bluesky:** It passes and has two paragraphs. It came in at 182 characters against the 300 limit.

The Bluesky count comes from the status file. I re-counted only the two repaired posts: X is 178 of 255 characters and LinkedIn is 507 of 2,950. The counts in the file (188 and 505) don't match, but both are under their limits either way.

I did not run the sub-agent critique or suggestions passes, so Bluesky has no advisory notes.

I also did not read the blog post, since the repairs were one-word or one-tag changes.
